footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Burford Capital: after $9.6M attributable to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 24.3% to $413M in 2025. Operating income fell 40.6% to $232M, a 56.2% margin.
Net income fell 57.3% to $62.6M, or $0.28 per share. Operating cash flow was −$29.0M and free cash flow −$29.3M, versus $216M; Burford Capital returned $15.3M through buybacks.
sources: Burford Capital Limited Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
